description: Source code for xmlHelper.c providing helper routines for XML node and attribute manipulation using libxml2, including content parsing, node creation, and attribute handling.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsInt
methods.description: Reads XML node content and interprets as a 32-bit integer, returning default if null.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsUnsignedInt
methods.description: Reads XML node content and interprets as an unsigned 32-bit integer, returning default if null.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsUnsignedLongLong
methods.description: Reads XML node content and interprets as an unsigned 64-bit integer, returning default if null.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsBoolean
methods.description: Reads XML node content and interprets as boolean ('true'/'1' as true).

methods.name: setXmlNodeContentsAsBoolean
methods.description: Sets XML node content to 'true' or 'false' based on boolean value.

methods.name: getXmlNodeContentsAsString
methods.description: Returns a duplicated string of XML node content or default if null.

methods.name: appendNewStringNode
methods.description: Creates and appends a new XML node with optional contents under a parent node.

methods.name: findChildNode
methods.description: Recursively searches for a child node with a given name.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsInt
methods.description: Reads an attribute as a 32-bit integer, returning default if not found.

methods.name: setXmlNodeAttributeAsInt
methods.description: Sets an integer attribute on an XML node.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsUnsignedInt
methods.description: Reads an attribute as an unsigned 32-bit integer.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsUnsignedLongLong
methods.description: Reads an attribute as an unsigned 64-bit integer.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsBoolean
methods.description: Reads an attribute as boolean ('true'/'1' as true).

methods.name: setXmlNodeAttributeAsBoolean
methods.description: Sets a boolean attribute ('true'/'false') on an XML node.

methods.name: getXmlNodeAttributeAsString
methods.description: Returns a duplicated string of an attribute value or default.
